prompt: I have washed 5 shirts and put them all out to dry at the same time. They all took 5 hours. If I wash 30 shirts and put them all out to dry at the same time, how long will they take to dry?
response:
If you wash 5 shirts and they all take 5 hours to dry when put out to dry at the same time, the drying time is dependent on factors like the amount of moisture in the shirts, the drying conditions (such as sunlight, wind, and temperature), and not on the number of shirts being dried simultaneously (assuming they all have enough space and exposure to the drying conditions).

Therefore, if you wash 30 shirts and put them all out to dry at the same time under the same conditions, they will also take 5 hours to dry, assuming they all have adequate space and exposure to the drying conditions. The drying time remains the same regardless of the number of shirts, as long as the drying conditions are consistent.
